agenda_text:
City of Encinitas
Special Commission for the Arts Meeting
AGENDA
SEPTEMBER 2, 2025 -
05:00 PM
City of Encinitas - Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Ave
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the Commission.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.
ROLL CALL
3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS Presentation by Brigid Parsons and CJ Dimento on the process of creating the Oceanside Arts Master Plan.
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF Each speaker has three (3) minutes to address the Commission for the Arts. There are no time donations during Oral Communications. Please submit a “WHITE” speaker slip to the Clerk. Direction to staff to bring back a future agenda item or provide additional information to answer a question requires consent of at least two Commission Members.
6.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announce administrative changes to the agenda in compliance with the Brown Act.
7.
APPROVAL OF THE MINUTES Approve the August 4, 2025, Regular Meeting Minutes.
7. August 4, 2025 Regular Meeting Minutes
8.
ACTION ITEMS
8A.
Commission for the Arts Annual Work Plan.
1.
Discuss the 2025-26 Work Plan and provide updates.
1.
Confirm which commissioner(s) will attend the Cultural Tourism Committee meeting on September 4, 2025.
2.
Discuss City Council-directed items
a.
Generate ideas that could help generate revenue funding to contribute to the Pacific View Arts Center with a goal for this work plan year to be a list of ideas generated. If it can be taken all the way to a program, that would be a stretch goal.
b.
Recommend goals and policies for the Arts that are consistent with all the other General Plan elements. Add something called out in the Recreation element that talks about arts.
3.
Discuss the City Mural Plan goal that includes research on feasibility and funding of a City Mural Program that includes program models, potential locations, outside funding sources, and public outreach methods. Provide a projected timeline for completion of this goal.
4.
Review and discuss proposed donation of public art sculpture from Encinitas Friends of the Arts by artist Deanne Sabeck.
5.
Review expenditures for the 2024 and 2025 Youth Piano Concerto Competitions and related concerts with North Coast Symphony Orchestra.
6.
Form ad hoc committees as needed to complete work plan goals.
